messages:
evan-billing: FYI customer LumiPort (LP-308) in Singapore had an auto-pay card decline. Processor reason: cross_border_block. They used a corporate card issued in SG for a USD invoice.
maya-support: Opening support ticket. Customer says their bank blocks foreign currency charges until they whitelist the vendor. They asked if we can accept SGD wire instead.
oliver-payments: Current token state = declined_by_issuer (cross-border). We attempted one retry which failed. payments-bot has blocked further automatic retries.
payments-bot: Auto-retries suspended for token lp-card-308 due to cross_border_block.
evans-billing: Invoice INV-2026-911 is USD 9,500. If customer wires in SGD we need to account for FX and fees. Proposal: accept SGD wire, post gross received to the USD invoice using day's conversion rate and GL rounding policy. Need accounting sign-off.
gloria-accounting: We can do that. We'll use bank's conversion rate on settlement date and book FX variance to account 8420. Add memo for reconciliation. Please require payer to include invoice ref.
rachel-sales: Customer is strategic APAC partner; approved to accept SGD wire. I'll request same-day wire and a screenshot of the initiated transfer.
omar-payments: (typo) -- oliver here. Operational notes: when accepting foreign currency wire, mark invoice awaiting_wire_foreign and create a wire watch ticket to match incoming amount. Also include beneficiary codes to ensure auto-match.
sam-legal: For cross-border wires, confirm we have required paperwork for KYC (beneficial owner) for funds > $5k. If not, request additional docs.
evans-billing: We have basic KYC but missing a beneficiary declaration. @rachel-sales please request a signed beneficiary confirmation and proof of funds.
rachel-sales: Asking customer now. Draft to customer: "We can accept SGD wire to cover your USD invoice. Please confirm you'd like to proceed and upload a signed beneficiary declaration and a screenshot of the initiated transfer. We'll send redacted wire details once confirmed."
maya-support: Payments-bot created provisional job watch-wdt-1839999999 for auto-match if payref present.
payments-bot: Job created: wire-watch-1839999999. Matching rules: reference contains INV-2026-911 or LP-308.
rachel-sales: Customer replied: "Yes proceed. We'll send SGD wire today. Attached beneficiary declaration and screenshot"
oliver-payments: Creating foreign-wire ticket FIN-3891. Will provide redacted wire template. Internal instructions (do not paste externally):
```
Bank: Redwood Intl (SG)
Acct: [redacted]
SWIFT: RWDXSGSG
Ref: INV-2026-911
Currency: SGD
```
gloria-accounting: Please include a note to customer that their bank's outgoing fees will reduce the gross amount; we will reconcile and invoice any shortfall.
evans-billing: Also flag potential tax withholding in SG; customer should confirm no local withholding applies or provide withholding certificate. Sam-legal, any docs needed?
sam-legal: If withholding applies, we need evidence to gross-up or claim treaty relief. Ask customer to confirm tax treatment.
oliver-payments: Wire incoming monitored. Setting invoice to awaiting_wire_foreign and adding 72h settlement window.
payments-bot: Wire watch set, timer 72h.
rachel-sales: Customer confirmed wire sent at 1840000065 and provided SWIFT trace screenshot.
oliver-payments: Trace received. Will mark invoice PAID once funds land and FX conversion applied.
gloria-accounting: Noted. Creating GL notes and reopening FIN-3891 for reconciliation steps.
evans-billing: Closing loop: invoice awaiting settlement. If wire shortfalls appear, we will invoice the remainder and notify customer. If funds don't arrive within 72h, re-open collection.
maya-support: Closing support ticket #66822. Customer happy with wire fallback. :thumbsup:
